<!-- pr-reviewer: 7c832000643bd4e5808ad0ff4ad97a34fd99ea91 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after its parents; see the stack note).

Reviewed at the high tier. Stacked on #957 / #993 / #1016, so I reviewed only this PR's own delta (`78fd6e80`, `7c832000`) and ran the suites that cover it.

**What looks good**
- Every change is a `map_err` on an error path (plus the `Ghost::after` / `GenError::after_moves` merge). I found no `Ok` branch where a refusal used to be.
- Refusal-stays-refusal: `with_ghost_moves` rewrites only `Invalid`/`At` into `Ghosted` (`gen_error.rs`), and `Ghosted` is still an `Err` variant. `Empty` and `Geo` pass through untouched, so the `Err(GenError::Empty(_)) => {}` arms in `entry.rs` (air-split, rest ladder) keep meaning "nothing to cut".
- The ghost never becomes a toolpath. It stays inside the error, and the only consumers are `commands/operation/generate.rs::machining` (turns it into `CommandError::MachiningGhost`), `script/api.rs` and `ui/state.rs` (`feedback_ghost`). It does not reach the op cache, the post or the sim.
- Frame discipline is explicit: the rotary ghost goes through `posed` and a ghost that `posed` refuses is dropped (empty path -> `map_path` None). The cross-drill spindle-frame ghost is shifted back by `(ox, oy)`, and a chain with arcs gets no ghost rather than a wrong-frame one. A non-finite join is refused, with the cap and truncation flag kept.
- Pinning tests exercise the frames (off-origin plate, off-origin bar, shift, nested merge).

**Local results** (merged with current main, clean merge, no conflicts; own `target/`, sccache)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| motion lib | 192 passed, 1 ignored |
| motion refusal_ghost / refusal_ghost_frames | 3 / 3 passed |
| motion rotary, rotary_links, rotary_offset, multiaxis, multiaxis_avoid, multiaxis_rough, swarf_reentry, swarf_pose_continuity, machining3d | all passed (10, 7, 9, 7, 6, 5, 2, 6, 23) |
| app lib | 126 passed |
| app refusal_ghost, operations, golden_cl, conformance, center_cut_owed | 4, 117 (6 ignored), 25, 6, 3 passed |
| app drilling_cross (+ holder, part, rapids, spindle), fixture_route, c_axis_live, c_axis_unwind, rotary_letter, rotary_verify | all passed |
| ui lib `refusal_ghost` | 5 passed |
| clippy -D warnings, motion + app, all targets | clean |

Goldens are unchanged and no snapshot PNG is touched. Not run by me: the sim/tools suites that come from the parent PRs, the full ui suite, and the ignored lanes.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- Merge order: #957, #993, #1016, then this PR. Until then the diff also shows the parents' commits (the PR touches 70+ files). Any of those moving changes what a re-check sees.
- Body lists `Fixes #1015` and a `Changelog:` line; the decisions file is `docs/decisions/1015-ghost-frames.md`. All good.
- The ghost is display-only, but the draw side (colour, ground ink) is in the parent #1016, so that part needs the maintainer's hand check there. This PR adds no UI code of its own.
- The unlabelled sites (`link_swings`, `guard_turns`, `radial_relink` lift) have no fixture that reaches them; they are covered only by construction. Fine as stated in "Not exercised".

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
